questions.text: The smallest natural number which is divisible by 24, 58, 48 and 12 is:

Pravin has ₹1612 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Rishi and Shan and asked them to invest it at 8% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Rishi and Shan got same amount after 17 and 18 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Pravin give to Rishi?
A sales man offers the following scheme discount on the sale of pencils in his shop: 'Buy 20 and get 5 free'. What is the percentage of his scheme discount?
If 2% of x = 288, then x is equal to:
The edge of a cube is 19 cm. What is the total surface area of the cube (in cm2)?

Mukund invests a sum of ₹5400 and Sachin invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 4 years, Sachin gets ₹960 more interest than Mukund, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
400 pears were bought at ₹1230 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹980. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of pears.
If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹44 and compound interest is ₹45, then what is the principal (in ₹)?

Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 60 km/h and 50 km/h. The length of one train is 430 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 44 seconds. The length (in m) of the other train, correct to 2 decimal places, is:

There are 49 members in group A, 35 members in group B and 31 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹106, ₹141 and ₹226, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
The average weight of 27 students of a class is 53 kg. If the weight of the teacher is included, the average rises by 700 grams. Find the weight (in kg) of the teacher.
Find the greatest number which on dividing 1657 and 2037, leaves remainders 6 and 5, respectively.

X can complete a task in 15 days, and Y can complete the same task in 20 days. If X and Y work on alternate days starting with X, in how many days will the work be completed?
Which of the following ratios is the highest?
